data.summary: Reviews appear largely authentic. The business has a strong, established reputation on Yelp with 345 reviews and a 4.8 rating. Google reviews are fewer but contain specific, credible details. Complaints focus on communication and pricing, not core service failure or fraud. The low Google review count relative to Yelp is a minor anomaly but not a strong fake signal. The BBB A+ rating with no visible complaints supports legitimacy.
fake_signals: Low review volume on Google (14 reviews) for a business with 345 Yelp reviews suggests possible review solicitation focus on one platform
Some Google reviews are brief and generic (e.g., 'Great job guys!')
authentic_signals: Specific details in reviews (e.g., 'Travis', '6 years ago', 'cleaner/booster pump', '15 year old pool')
Mix of praise and specific complaints with details
Emotional authenticity in both positive and negative reviews
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are generally positive and consistent. The Yelp rating (4.8) is higher than Google (4.4), but this is a common pattern as Yelp often has a more curated, positive review base. The BBB A+ rating indicates good complaint handling. No major contradictions exist.

He gave me advice on what to check since I no longer can afford pool service! 6 years later and he still provided customer service to me! 10 stars if it was an option. Thank you Travis! I will recommend y'all to any and all!!

Jim Beall
Little Elm.
reviews.author: JB Don't ask

reviews.text: So I have been using this company & Travis and his son for some time now.  Lately I noticed my bills kept going up and up.  From $190 "the original promised price to $365 a month.  I kindly asked Travis to get me invoices for the last 5 months to see what I was charged.  He immediately got defensive, and said: "We're not trying to screw you".  That to me was a red flag.  After 2 weeks of waiting for the invoices.  They send me invoices showing they raised their prices for supplies, trip charges, and 5th week cleaning.  They never disclosed these fees or charges with me.  I called to go over the fees with Travis.  He said his son placed the invoices in my mail box every month.  That was a lie.  Then their office Lady Valerie said they were mailed out to me.   That was a lie.  Then she said they emailed them.  They did not have my email until today 10/03/2023.  I'm writing this review, because I want to warn everyone to ask for a contract.  Frisco pools does not have a contract.  Get everything in writing, 5th week charge, $65 trip charge for work they charge $165 for, and much more.  Needless this is a company with pool business systems, poor communications, and weak leadership & weak team work.
reviews.author: Scott Thompson

reviews.text: Hey just wanted to leave this for people to hear, had a few things needing repair on my 15 year old pool here in Frisco and Travis and his assistant did a great job. Fair pricing, quick service, and professional. Really appreciate his expertise and highly recommend.
